title: Connector config + policy surfaces (FK3b)
description: Fork-native operational config — NOT part of the canonical docs/schemas store-model extraction. Policy-neutral (fork §3a): the tool enforces whatever this holds and ships holding no opinion. Two gates on ingestion: opt-in `enabled` (default false, always active) and the optional `allowlist` (empty = no constraint; populated = only listed sources permitted — the user's/org's rule).

allowlist.description: The neutral configuration point. Empty = no allowlist constraint applied (no opinion). Non-empty = only these source_ids (or workspaces) may be ingested, even when enabled. Holds the user's/org's rule; ships empty.

source_id.description: Stable id used in allowlist + provenance

type.description: e.g. mcp, slack, gmail, drive, local-folder

workspace.description: Provenance: which workspace/account this source draws from (Ledger 3 answers 'which workspace did this come from')

enabled.description: Opt-in gate. Default false: nothing is read until the responsible party toggles it (the toggle IS them exercising policy).

dm_email.description: arch: DMs/email are opt-in sources — nothing reads them until this is true (FK3b toggle, ledgered)

notification_channels.description: Outbound channels (FK5 Brief delivery). Slack DM for the pilot.

target.description: Principal's authenticated Slack user id (CN-1) or DM target
